facts.text: Melanie and her children participated in a pottery workshop on Friday, where they made their own clay sculptures.

evidence.quote: Last Fri I finally took my kids to a pottery workshop. We all made our own pots, it was fun and therapeutic!
The kids loved it! They were so excited to get their hands dirty and make something with clay.

facts.text: Melanie and her children created a clay sculpture of a cup with a dog face, which was photographed and shared with Caroline.

evidence.quote: They made this! [image: a photo of a cup with a dog face on it]

facts.text: Melanie and her children recently engaged in a nature-inspired painting project, which resulted in a painting of a sunset with a palm tree.

evidence.quote: What other creative projects do you do with them, besides pottery?
We love painting together lately, especially nature-inspired ones. Here's our latest work from last weekend. [image: a photo of a painting of a sunset with a palm tree]

facts.text: Melanie and her children collaborated on a painting of a field of purple flowers with green leaves, which was photographed and shared with Caroline.

evidence.quote: We both helped with the painting - it was great bonding over it and chatting about nature. We found these lovely flowers. [image: a photo of a field of purple flowers with green leaves]
